jobs.title: (Remote) Sr Implementation Consultant
jobs.description:
Systems \& Software, a division of Harris; is seeking a Sr Implementation Consultant who will join the Professional Services team.


The ideal candidate is an enthusiastic, team\-oriented professional who provides outstanding customer service, has excellent deductive and analytical abilities, and thrives on delivering project milestones in a fast\-paced environment.


Utilizing industry best practices, methodologies, and process controls, the Sr Implementation Consultant will be responsible for working with a project team to deliver enQuesta CIS solutions and associated value\-added services to both new and existing customers. This includes performing business process requirements analysis and documentation as well as system configuration, testing, implementation, training, and support.


The Sr Implementation Consultant is customer\-facing and plays a key role in effectively translating customer requirements into solution deliverables.

**This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US. Travel is required as needed, approximately 75%. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean.**

**Salary:**

**85K \- 100K**

**AI \& Innovation Mindset**


We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.

 **What your impact will be:**

* Define and understand client business requirements; interpret and apply the information within the scope of the project.
* Configure the software using workflow and business rules to allow clients to conduct their business processes.
* Work with data conversion specialists to achieve a smooth transition of legacy data.
* Train end users on the software in both remote and classroom\-led sessions.
* Be adept on the functionality and capabilities of the software, making enhancement requests to Product Development when appropriate.
* Work with cross\-functional team members including Project Managers, Data Conversion Specialists, Quality Assurance, Technical Support Analysts, and other Implementation Specialists.
* Provide CIS subject matter expertise and consulting services for one or more project teams assigned to new customer implementations, upgrades, and quotes.
* Participate in discovery sessions with clients to establish current\-state and future\-state processes and produce documentation as required.
* Assist data conversion resources with data mapping and validation.
* Draft and execute software testing based on best practices and customer requirements.
* Document training materials and effectively train end users.
* Serve as a customer advocate and facilitate communication with other internal departments.
* Provide support during customer testing, production implementation, and beyond.

**What we are looking for:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Accounting, Information Systems, a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 5\+ years of CIS, Utility Industry, S\&S enQuesta, JIRA, Confluence, and Clarizen experience is a plus.
* Experience with electric rate configuration, implementation, and ongoing maintenance in a CIS billing system.
* Experience with MDM systems with emphasis on billable read workflows.
* Excellent customer service and oral/written communication skills.
* Exceptional problem\-solving skills. Must be able to assess information to make autonomous conclusions quickly and effectively.
* Demonstrated ability to listen and interpret requirements, recommend solutions, and drive or participate in business process analysis sessions with customers.
* Detail\-oriented and conscientious about meeting expectations.
* Positive, proactive, and action\-oriented attitude and approach.
* Ability to effectively manage a large number of tasks simultaneously, with excellent organizational skills.
* Familiarity with, or dedication to learning, intermediate SQL commands/statements to aid in problem solving and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with standard UNIX/SSH and FTP commands for interface file manipulation.
* Familiarity and experience working with AI such as Claude or Copilot.

**What we can offer:**

* 3 weeks’ vacation and 5 personal days
* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits starting from your first day of employment
* Employee stock ownership and RRSP/401k matching programs
* Lifestyle rewards
* Remote work and more!

**About Systems \& Software:**


Systems \& Software, a subsidiary of Harris Computer and part of Constellation Software, has been serving utilities and municipalities since 1973\. Headquartered in Vermont, the company provides the enQuesta CIS platform to manage billing and utility operations for electric, water, gas, wastewater, solid waste, and property taxes. Our solutions enable utilities to manage complex rate structures, streamline operations, and enhance customer service, all without the need for custom code or disconnected systems. With cloud\-based deployment, SOC 2 Type II certification, and interoperability with meter data systems, GIS, and financial tools, Systems \& Software delivers stability, security, and flexibility that utilities can trust. Our commitment to ongoing investment ensures continuous innovation and a strong partnership with our customers across North America.

**About Harris:**


Harris is a leading provider of mission critical software to the public sector in North America. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc. (“CSI”, symbol CSU on the TSX), Harris has become the cornerstone for CSI’s investment in utility, local government, school districts, public safety, and healthcare software verticals. Our success has been realized through investments in our proprietary software and market expertise. This focus, combined with acquiring businesses that build upon or complement our offerings, has helped drive our success. Harris will continue to growth through reinvestment – both in the people and products that we offer and making investments in acquiring new businesses.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Implementation Specialist**
=============================

**About the Role**
------------------


Prospyr is looking for an **Implementation Specialist** to help new customers successfully transition onto Prospyr and get their teams operational as quickly and confidently as possible.


You’ll own the implementation process from post\-sale handoff through go\-live, coordinating configuration, data migration, workflows, training, and launch readiness.


This role is highly project\-oriented. You'll manage multiple implementations simultaneously while working closely with customers and internal teams to keep projects organized, remove blockers, and ensure customers are prepared to operate successfully in Prospyr.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Implementation Project Management**

* Own customer implementations from Sales handoff through successful go\-live.
* Build and manage implementation plans, milestones, responsibilities, and timelines.
* Coordinate customer and internal stakeholders throughout the project.
* Identify risks, dependencies, and blockers early and drive them toward resolution.
* Maintain clear communication around project status and next steps.

### **Platform Configuration**

* Guide customers through configuration of their Prospyr environment.
* Help customers translate existing operational workflows into Prospyr.
* Coordinate setup across areas such as:


	+ Providers and staff
	+ Locations
	+ Scheduling
	+ Services and catalog
	+ Forms and consents
	+ Payments
	+ Patient communications
	+ Inventory
	+ Memberships
	+ Online booking
	+ Integrations and other applicable features
* Validate configuration prior to go\-live.

### **Data Migration \& Integrations**

* Coordinate data migration requirements between customers and internal technical teams.
* Help customers understand what data is required and how it should be prepared.
* Track migration progress and validate readiness with the customer.
* Coordinate third\-party integrations and dependencies when applicable.
* Escalate technical blockers with clear documentation and business impact.

### **Training \& Go\-Live Readiness**

* Coordinate and deliver role\-based customer training.
* Ensure administrators, providers, front\-desk teams, and other users understand the workflows relevant to their roles.
* Develop a clear go\-live readiness checklist for each implementation.
* Identify knowledge gaps before launch and coordinate additional training where needed.
* Provide additional support during the transition into live operations.

### **Process Improvement**

* Identify recurring implementation friction and opportunities to improve Prospyr's onboarding process.
* Help develop implementation templates, playbooks, checklists, documentation, and training resources.
* Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring implementation blockers.
* Help move repeatable onboarding activities toward scalable self\-service experiences.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Customers launch on time with minimal disruption to their businesses.
* Implementation timelines and responsibilities are clear to customers and internal teams.
* Data migration and configuration issues are identified before go\-live.
* Customers enter ongoing CX management with strong platform knowledge and clearly defined workflows.
* Time\-to\-value and time\-to\-go\-live improve as implementation processes become more standardized.
* Fewer post\-launch support issues originate from incomplete configuration or training.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 2–4\+ years of SaaS implementation, onboarding, project management, or customer success experience.
* Strong project\-management and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple customer implementations simultaneously.
* Comfortable learning complex software and becoming highly proficient in product configuration.
* Strong customer communication and training skills.
* Ability to troubleshoot problems and coordinate effectively with technical teams.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment where processes continue to evolve.
* Healthcare, EMR, medical aesthetics, wellness, payments, or vertical SaaS experience is a plus.

**Role Philosophy**
-------------------


Implementation owns the question:

**“What needs to happen to get this customer successfully live on Prospyr?”**


The Implementation Specialist drives that process from beginning to end, while creating a clean transition to the CXM who will own the customer's long\-term success.

jobs.title: EMR Integration Specialist
jobs.description:
**A Rare Opportunity to Shape the Future of Genomics**
------------------------------------------------------



Join a team of brilliant, passionate innovators determined to transform healthcare. At BillionToOne, we've built a category\-defining, publicly traded company on Nasdaq where transparency fuels trust, collaboration drives breakthroughs, and every contribution moves the needle on our mission to make life\-changing diagnostics accessible to all. We don't just aim for incremental improvements; we build products that are 10x better than anything that exists today.



Our scientists, engineers, sales executives, and visionaries are united by an unwavering commitment to changing the standard of care in prenatal and cancer diagnostics. This is where cutting\-edge science meets human compassion, and every innovation you contribute helps remove the fear of the unknown from some of life's most critical medical moments.



If you're driven by purpose, energized by innovation, and ready to help shape the future of precision medicine at scale, this is where you belong.



BillionToOne is looking to hire an **EMR Integration Specialist** to join our EMR Success team that supports our prenatal and oncology sales representatives in ensuring the best possible experience for healthcare providers. You will drive successful implementation of EMR solutions and ensure healthcare providers can easily access UNITY and Northstar functionality within their EMR. This position offers an exciting opportunity to collaborate across a dynamic team and contribute to the advancement of highly innovative technology. This position is remote and will report to an EMR Success Manager.


**Responsibilities:**


* Collaborate with sales, healthcare providers/systems and/or their IT teams to implement EMR solutions in\-person and virtually
* Act as subject matter expert and primary point\-of\-contact for our prenatal and oncology sales teams on all of BillionToOne's EMR solutions
* Provide customer support, troubleshooting assistance, and end\-user training on all solutions
* Lead key activities such as workflow assessment, roll\-out planning, training plans, go\-live support, etc.
* Post\-implementation, own the live customer relationship and act as the main point of contact for any issues, changes, etc.
* Identify and champion new EMR solutions, vendor partnerships, and interoperability opportunities for BillionToOne
* Work closely with sales representatives and technical analysts to continuously evaluate and enhance the customer onboarding experience.


**Requirements:**


* Minimum 3\+ years of hands\-on experience working in EMR systems or patient/provider portals, ideally at a diagnostic company or CLIA lab
* Strong understanding of CLIA labs, healthcare organizations, and EMR implementations and how to bridge together all 3
* Strong ability to build effective relationships with clients and staff at all levels
* Very tech\-savvy – previous experience in a technical role is a plus
* Ability to work cohesively with cross\-functional teams, both internally and externally, and effectively manage expectations
* Willingness to travel up to 50% throughout the US


**Nice\-to\-Haves:**


* End\-user experience in more than one common EMR vendor, including Epic, Cerner, athena, eClinicalWorks, etc.
* Existing IT contacts at health systems/IDNs


**Benefits And Perks:**


* Working alongside brilliant, kind, passionate and dedicated colleagues, in an empowering environment, toward a global vision, striving for a future in which transformative molecular diagnostics can help millions of patients
* Open, transparent culture that includes weekly Town Hall meetings
* The ability to indirectly or directly change the lives of hundreds of thousand patients
* Multiple medical benefit options; employee premiums paid 100% of select plans, dependents covered up to 80%
* Extremely generous Family Bonding Leave for eligible employees (16 weeks, paid at 100%)
* Supplemental fertility benefits coverage
* Retirement savings program including a 4% Company match
* Increase paid time off with increased tenure
* Latest and greatest hardware (laptop, lab equipment, facilities)


At BillionToOne, we are proud to offer a combination of (1\) competitive base pay, (2\) generous equity options offering, (3\) corporate bonus program, on top of (4\) industry leading company benefits (free healthcare options, 401k match, very generous fully paid parental leave, etc.).



For this position, we offer a total compensation package of $186,750 per year, including a base pay range of $144,699 \- $166,136 per year.


*BillionToOne is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*
For more information about how we protect your information, we encourage you to review our Privacy Policy.



BillionToOne is a next\-generation molecular diagnostics company on a mission to make powerful, accurate diagnostic tests accessible to everyone. Our revolutionary QCT molecular counting technology enhances disease detection resolution by over a thousandfold using cell\-free DNA,a breakthrough that has already transformed the lives of over half a million patients worldwide.


### **Our Impact**


**Unity Complete™** is the only non\-invasive prenatal screen capable of assessing fetal risk for both common recessive conditions and aneuploidies from a single maternal blood sample.
  

**Unity Confirm™**enables non\-invasive confirmation for high\-risk screening results through the capture of intact circulating fetal cells using BillionToOne's Fetal Cell Capture™ Technology.
  

Our **Northstar®** liquid biopsy test uniquely combines treatment selection with real\-time monitoring, giving oncologists unprecedented precision in cancer care.


### **Our Growth**



From $0 to $400M\+ annualized revenue run\-rate in just 6 years. In 2025, we completed one of the most successful IPOs for a medical diagnostics company, building on nearly $400M in private funding,including our $130M Series D in 2024 and backed by world\-class investors including Hummingbird, Adams Street Partners, Neuberger Berman, Baillie Gifford, and Premji Invest.


### **Our Recognition**



Forbes named us one of **America's Best Startup Employers for 2025** and we're **Great Place to Work certified**, with 100% of our people willing to go the extra mile, even as we've scaled to over 700 employees.


### **Our Future**



Headquartered in Menlo Park with facilities in Union City, CA, and a new lab opening in Austin, TX in 2027, we're continuing to push the boundaries of what's possible in molecular diagnostics. We're just getting started.



Ready to help us change the world, one molecule at a time? Learn more at billiontoone.com

In this role, you’ll partner closely with your manager to deliver hands\-on, technical training that helps our warehouse team sharpen their skills. From onboarding new hires to reinforcing best practices across departments and shifts, you’ll ensure training remains consistent, engaging, and effective.


You’ll be a key player in boosting productivity, improving accuracy, and building confidence across the team.


If you're passionate about helping others grow, thrive in a fast\-paced environment, and enjoy making learning fun, we’d love to meet you.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Provide high quality technical/hard skill training to newly hired employees as part of a robust onboarding program within the distribution center.
* Administer ongoing technical training to all applicable employees during new process rollouts, system changes or after the identification of knowledge/experience gaps.
* Communicate and collaborate with team leads and employees across departments and shifts to identify training needs and opportunities for continuous improvement
* Support high performance standards using coaching, training, and development strategies that drive operational best practices across departments
* Maintain a high level of operating knowledge and positive employee relations
* Provide professional and constructive feedback to employees throughout the training process, based on company standards and expectations
* Serve as a resource for all employees regarding job tasks, company policies and procedures and warehouse initiatives
* Collaborate with the Manager of Training \& Development on best practices for effective training strategies
* Work closely with team members and leadership to meet daily, weekly, and monthly departmental goals
* Abide by all company and warehouse policies
* Flex into other positions and departments and undertake additional duties as necessary to support the overall operation

**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------

* Work is performed while standing and/or walking, up to and including 12 hours/day.
* Requires the ability to communicate effectively using speech, vision, and hearing.
* Requires the regular use of hands for simple grasping and fine manipulations.
* Requires regular bending, squatting, crawling, climbing, and reaching.
* Requires the ability to regularly lift, carry, push, or pull medium weights, up to 75lbs.

**Experience**
--------------

* Experience working in a distribution or manufacturing environment preferred

**Education**
-------------

* This role does not require a degree. We value relevant skills and experience and alignment with our core values above all else.

**Desired Traits \& Skills**
----------------------------

* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Strong emotional intelligence required with the ability to establish rapport and connect with others in\-person and remotely.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and within a team.
* Proficiency with MS Office required (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and comfortable working in a high\-tech environment.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.

**Company Overview**

The foodservice professional’s premier source for restaurant equipment, supplies, and knowledge online. Our purpose is to empower and equip people to run their businesses more profitably and efficiently.

jobs.title: Court Reporting Onboarding & Training Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Remote Legal**  

At Remote Legal, our 40\-year legacy is built on the expertise of seasoned attorneys and dedicated court reporters who are passionate about transforming the legal process. We're not a flash\-in\-the\-pan tech startup—instead, we blend time\-honored legal experience with innovative technology to redefine how depositions are conducted. Our team spans legal professionals, product owners, engineers, client\-success leads, and security specialists, all collaborating seamlessly to ensure every deposition is a success. Join us, and become part of a community where rich experience meets forward\-thinking innovation, and where your talents help make the legal journey better for everyone. **About the role**  

The Reporter Training Specialist\- Testimony Capture is responsible for sourcing, onboarding, and training court reporters within the Testimony Capture department. This role helps design and maintain training programs, documentation, and quality standards to ensure reporters are fully prepared to deliver high\-quality services. Works cross\-functionally with Operations, Assignments, Production, and Customer Support to support reporter readiness, platform proficiency, and ongoing performance.

 **What you'll do*** Sources court reporters through approved recruiting platforms, including Rippling
* Conducts interviews, evaluates qualifications, and supports hiring decisions for reporters
* Manages onboarding process, including documentation, system access, and initial readiness checks
* Trains reporters on company processes, operational expectations, and quality standards
* Delivers training on Remote Legal platforms and related technology tools
* Creates, maintains, and updates training scenarios, guides, and reference materials
* Develops procedures and training documentation to support consistency and quality across reporting team
* Coordinates with Operations and Assignments to identify training needs and performance gaps
* Provides refresher training, updates, and process rollouts as procedures evolve
* Supports remediation and targeted retraining when quality or compliance issues are identified
* Maintains accurate training records and onboarding documentation for reporters
* Monitors training effectiveness and recommends improvements based on feedback and outcomes
* Ensures training aligns with legal, procedural, and company standards
* Develop, review, and update the quality rubric to ensure alignment with company standards
* Establish and enforce a consistent cadence for feedback
* Facilitate and lead regular quality calibration sessions
* Create and distribute detailed feedback based on quality reviews and audits
* Review markups and scorecards prepared by others for accuracy and consistency
* Maintains strict confidentiality of all company, client, and reporter information
* Recruits, onboards, trains, and oversees direct reports as assigned; provides coaching, guidance, and development
* Sets team priorities, allocates workload, and ensures coverage for onboarding, training delivery, and quality reviews
* Leads performance management activities for direct reports, including goal setting, ongoing feedback, documentation, and support for corrective action when needed
* Establishes repeatable team workflows, documentation standards, and knowledge\-sharing routines to support consistent delivery and coverage
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Qualifications*** Strong training, facilitation, and instructional design skills
* Ability to clearly communicate processes and technical concepts
* Strong organizational and documentation skills
* Ability to manage multiple onboarding and training workflows simultaneously
* High attention to detail and quality standards
* Problem\-solving mindset with ability to adapt training to reporter needs
* Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop team members in a remote environment
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, remote environment
* Experience with court reporting workflows or legal proceedings preferred
* Ability to collaborate cross\-functionally with multiple departments

**Education and Experience**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor’s degree preferred (or equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience).
* 2\-5 years of professional experience, including:


o Experience in training, onboarding, operations, or related roles
o Experience in legal, court reporting, or related environments **W****ork Environment*** This is a primarily remote position performed from a home office or approved remote work location; limited travel may be required periodically for training, meetings, or other business needs.
* All work is conducted through secure, company\-approved technology platforms via computer, phone, and video conferencing platforms.
* Reliable high\-speed internet access and a private, secure workspace are required.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to work for extended periods at a computer workstation in a remote, home\-based environment.
* Ability to perform repetitive motions, including frequent typing, keyboarding, and use of a mouse or other input devices.
* Ability to view computer screens, read digital documents, and analyze information for prolonged periods.
* Ability to occasionally adjust or move home office equipment weighing up to 10 pounds
* Some evening or weekend work may be required depending on client needs or emergency situations.
* Ability to travel to surrounding areas or states as needed.
